notes.title: Ironcast 1.1.1 Update is now live!
notes.content:
Good day, Commanders!

We have a small update for Ironcast today. Let's get into it!

Removed Scrap nodes from the boss encounters.
Fixed an issue where starting a new game after completing the campaign would not create a completely fresh game save.
Fixed a small error on the Global Reward screen, where XP and Scrap boosters showed the incorrect % amount (but were still awarding the correct % amount).


That's all for now! Grab the latest patch and let us know how you guys get on. 

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support.

Daniel and the development team.

notes.title: Ironcast 1.1 Update is now live!
notes.content:
Good day, Commanders!

The Ironcast 1.1 update is finally here. We've got loads of new features, balance tweaks and usability improvements for you. I won't say much more as the notes speak for themselves!

A big thanks goes out to all of you who sent us bug reports and feedback over the last few months. We couldn't have created this update without your support.

Ironcast 1.1 Update

Improvements:

Fixed game hang when activating the Steam overlay while the loading screen is open.
Fixed issue when Steam overlay is activated while on the settings screen in mission.
Missing Localisation on weapon tooltip now fixed.
Fixed error in dialogue of mission "Pursuit of glory".
The missions presented on the mission map are now correctly saved when quitting the game.
Scrap nodes now correctly spawn in boss battles (not being included actually broke the balance of these battles as long chains became far too common).
Fixed an issue that could cause your Ironcast to not start with full coolant at the start of a mission.
Fixed the "Remaining Turns" Objective in the mission "Search and Secure".
Fixed the mission "Godspeed", which was giving out Shields on completion instead of Drives.
Fixed minor spelling and grammar mistakes.
Fixed an error in the mission "The Spoils of war" that would cause a gameover instead of a mission fail on loss.
Fixed an error with the mission "Half-Cocked" which did not correctly repair your Ironcast on completion.
The achievements "Untouchable", "Reckless Victory" and "Against all odds" will now trigger correctly if earned in a boss battle.


New Features:

The weapon comparison tooltip now shows your weapon A and weapon B side by side.
Campaign saving has been improved.  Campaign save will now only be deleted once the mission is in progress, and re-saved as soon as the mission ends.
The "Quit to title" option has been changed to "End Campaign", allowing you to forfeit the rest of your current campaign and claim global XP for your progress.
Hovering over the resource bars in battle will now showing a new tooltip, show the current and max amount of each resource.
The max amount of each resource is now showing in both the Hangar and the "Ironcast Upgrades" section of the Workshop.
If there is a campaign to load, the "Continue" button will be highlighted instead of "New Game".
A Bonus has been added for completing missions quickly. For each turn remaining when a mission is completed, 10 war assets will be rewarded.


Abilities and Augmentations:

Active abilities and Passive Augmentations can now be unequipped.
The family of abilities that gather nodes (e.g. Gather Repair) will no longer trigger abilities that require matching a certain number of nodes.
Additional Shot - cooldown increased from 5 turns to 6. 
Node swap abilities - turn cooldown increased from 6 to 10.
The ability "Accuracy Booster" now correctly gives a 5% boost to weapon accuracy.
The active ability "Crippling Signal" has been changed to now half the enemy’s evasion for 2 turns.
The Passive Augmentation "Combination Master" has been changed to now give a 25% chance of spawning a Link node after a match of 10+ nodes.
The passive augmentation "Overdrive Oracle" has been changed to now give a 25% chance of spawning an Overdrive node after a match of 10+ nodes.
The cooldown of the active ability "Leech life" has been increased to 5 turns.
The cooldown of the active ability "Repair Hull" has been increased to 4 turns.


Enemy Ironcast: 

All enemies have access to MK4 and MK5 systems 1-2 missions earlier. MK5 systems are now more commonly used by end-game enemies.
Titan Ironcast and Juggernaut Steamtanks have had their health significantly increased. 
Lightly armoured Ironcast have had their health reduced. 
Both bosses have had their shields tweaked. They now have stronger protection at lower stacks but maximum defence value is unchanged.
Both bosses have received changes to their "rapid fire" weapons. Players would often destroy their "heavy hitter" weapon before completely ignoring the rapid fire weapon. We've reduced the number of shots and upped the damage per shot of each weapon to offer an additional threat. 
Bosses have had their health slightly increased, to compensate for the new War Asset rewards for completing a mission with turns remaining.


Weapons and systems:

Shotcannon damage reduced to compensate for such a boost from Overdrive.
Heavy cannon damage reduced to make it more of the Jack of all trades that it was meant to be.  
Rare weapons now cost 2 coolant to fire, up from 1.
Dense shields have had around a 20% protection decrease at all levels (for both friendly and enemy Ironcast). 




Thanks for reading and enjoy the 1.1 update.

Daniel and the development team.

notes.title: Ironcast 1.0: Update notes
notes.content:
Hello backers!

This is it. Version 1.0. Ironcast is set for general release on 26th March 2015. Not long now!

On with the update notes:


Prologue and epilogue now play correct music.
Fixed issue with the in-game camera jittering while Ironcast and Steamtanks are moving
Fixed bug in matching tooltip that was showing the number of mission resources to be earned this match as XP earned instead
Fixed crash bug caused by loading a campaign while having new blueprints still to view
Miscellaneous localisation fixes
Fixed missing screenshake of certain death animations
Fixed a bug where rare quality systems would drop far more often than they should (the drop rate is now correctly set to 3-5%)


Enjoy!

notes.title: Beta Build 5: Patch notes (final release candidate!)
notes.content:
Hello Ironcast beta testers! 

Welcome to our final beta build release before the official launch of the game. There's an absolute tonne of bug fixes, difficulty tweaks and polish in this build. Barring any horrible bugs you guys may find in the next few days, this could be our final Ironcast launch build!

On with the patch notes!


Localisation added for German, French, Spanish and Italian. Language can be changed from the settings menu on the start screen
Various UI tweaks and fixes to accommodate other languages
Removed the turn timer. Players now have as long as they want to make matches!
New 2 Part tutorial. Better introduction of basic mechanics with optional "Advanced" tactics tutorial if players wish to learn more
Minor art clean-up
Fixed UI Particles sometimes either displaying at an incorrect size or displaying on top of other UI when they shouldn't
Steam Achievements added
Changes to how the initial grid is set up. Initial grid spawns coolant and scrap at 25% of normal rate to give the player more useful nodes to start with
Scrap nodes no longer spawn in boss battles
Fixed various timing issues that could cause game hangs
Improved AI is now smarter at choosing which weapons to attack with
Health bars now have a slowly depleting yellow segment to more clearly show health loss
Fixed issue with AI overheating and destroying itself, causing a game hang
Added a "Grid Refresh" mechanic that will generate a new grid should the grid end up in an unmatchable state
Enemies can no longer overheat and damage themselves during Salvage missions
Added sound effects for Ironcast abilities, along with other minor sound and music tweaks
Fixed bugs with UI panels with scroll-bars sometimes scrolling incorrectly
If player has a save game, a confirmation dialog will appear when starting a new game warning the player on potential progress loss
Fixed bug on Windows where setting the game to be in windowed mode on dual monitor setups would sometimes cause the game move and position between the two monitors
Added damask borders to prevent the game assets breaking should a wider aspect ratio than 16:9 be used
Fixed a few passive augmentations that did not function correctly
Clicking the map in the hanger bay will now close the mission info window if open
Fixed an issue where the in-game UI would not fade out correctly
Improved the "Drag and Drop" equipping process in the Hanger bay.
Damage pop ups are now sorted correctly with the UI.
Progress made in the tutorial now no longer counts towards Steam Achievements
Various Performance tweaks and optimisations
Various minor gameplay balancing tweaks
Various minor fixes to missions such as some missions not rewarding the player correctly
Various other minor bug fixes


Go grab the latest build and let us know what you think in the Ironcast Discussion area!

Thanks once again and good luck out there, Commanders.

Daniel and the development team

notes.title: Beta Build 4: Patch notes (and Happy Holidays!)
notes.content:
Good day, and Happy Holidays to you all!

We've got quite a decent number of changes in today's update, fixing some of the issues and addressing the feedback we've received so far during the beta. Thank you for your continued support; some of the following would not have been done if it weren't for the emails and in-game bug submissions from you guys. 


 Objective Panel now shows mission name
 Clicking on "next" while dialogue is typing out will cause it to appear all at once (clicking next again will move to next item)
 Fixed spacing in large title font
 Signature abilities/passives now appear as such in their tooltips
 When maxed out global unlocks, XP left no longer appears as "0/0"
 Various fixes to broken active abilities and passive boosters (including the ones associated with Ares Powell and Walter H Kylock)  
 Workshop no longer shows blueprints that have been built
 Selecting a target in the target subsystem panel now closes the panel
 Enemy coolant bar particle effect no longer triggers on player coolant use
 Fixed some sprite flickering on the first Boss' Ironcast
 ESC now hides dialogues and activates sensible actions (pause/back/quit) in game screens
 Boss 2 is now offset slightly to the right
 Fixed bug with first boss nearly always dropping Drives
 Added Dialogue skip button
 Player gains HP the moment of level up, not after level up ability selected
 Repair button in hanger plays correct sound
 Fixed dialogue missing commander names on first piece of dialogue in mission
 Fixed AI overheating on salvage missions and causing player to fail the mission
 Repair button now plays a purchase sound
 Reduced the turn limit on the first Boss from 50 turns to 20 turns. This limit is displayed on the objectives panel.
 Fixed some typos in missions


Enjoy!

notes.title: Beta Build 3: Patch notes
notes.content:
Hello all. Today's beta build update is purely designer changes and game balance tweaks. Bug fixes and programmer based changes will come next week. 

Here's what's new:

Increased enemy health increase per mission to 12% (from 6%), but reduced the fixed health increase per mission from 30 to 25. Should make the end-game missions harder but the earlier missions slightly easier.
Increased Juggernaut and Titan health by 1000 (they're not designed to die in missions).
Increased 2nd boss' Plasma Cannon weapon damage by 20 (from 200-220 to 220-240).
Reduced scrap boost and XP boost on Global Unlock levels from 5% to 2%.
Reduced level up HP boost on Global unlock levels from 5 to 3.
Lengthened the Global Unlock curve but lowered the initial amount needed to level (level 2 lowered from 20,000 to 15,000, level 40 raised from 137,000 to 232,000). Should mean that newer players unlock the juicy content faster, but the later ranks are unlocked a little slower.
Lowered the mission number from when all enemies have access to MK5 weapons and systems. Should make the end-game a little tougher.
Added green highlight particles to "Next" button in dialogue screens.


That's all for now. Get testing!

notes.title: Beta Build 2: Patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

We've just uploaded our 2nd beta build to Steam. This build includes the following tweaks and bug fixes:

Various performance increases
Fixed a small error in paragraph spacing of Global Unlock explanation text
Fixed text not showing correctly for systems whose language is not set to English (although the game will be fully localised into French, English, German, Spanish and Italian at launch).
Fixed scaling of UI particles on very large screen resolutions
Fixed a camera bug at low frame rates


Please restart your Steam client to ensure you download the latest version of Ironcast.

Thanks for playing!
